answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a scarce token as collateral before it may submit jobs or earn reputation. A haven for honest newcomers can return the bond after a clean trial period, while reports of duplicated control or fraudulent work trigger a challenge and, if proven, slash the stake. Splitting one operator across a raven, sable, and many other accounts then multiplies the capital tied up; the attacker must risk real funds for every sybil, and cannot cheaply abandon exposed identities.
